chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Muhammad ibn Hassaan from Ismail ibn Mihran from al-Hasan from Sayf ibn 'Umayra from Abi Bakr al-Hadhrami from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever recites the Surah 'Lam' is free from polytheism and enters the religion of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, raises him as a believer, and He takes his account with a very easy reckoning.

key_terms.الشِّرْکِ: Polytheism or associating partners with God
key_terms.حِساباً یَسِیراً: A very easy reckoning/accounting on the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards of reciting Surah Al-Bayyinah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-Amal*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the purifying power of Surah Al-Bayyinah, linking its recitation directly to liberation from *shirk* and entry into the true faith. The promise of a 'light reckoning' (*hisab yaseer*) underscores the Surah's role in validating the prophethood of Muhammad (SAW) and the Imams, a central theme in Shia theology regarding divine guidance.
